text: so the app has been sitting idle for about 30 minutes or so and my memory is just climbing. its now at 1.37g from where it was when i first looked. The next step is to just like the performance logs we need a breakdown of what is accumulating memory here
resolution: Added memory accumulation instrumentation to the editor performance dock: system telemetry now exposes process RSS high-water, anonymous/file/shared resident splits, VM data/stack/lib/swap, and thread count from /proc/self/status. The FPS/performance popover now includes a resettable memory accumulation section ranked by growth since reset, feeds memory rows into top consumers, and the dock MEM readout opens the same diagnostics surface.
